items.title: Bill Dobbins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rochester, New York, January 11, 2012
items.q: I had heard the Thad Jones and Mel Lewis things

ctx.x: And so the next year he came back and brought Joe Williams. This was just a year or so after he had recorded that record with Thad Jones-Mel Lewis, with arrangements by Bob Brookmeyer and Thad. And so he brought all those arrangements with him. And we were in heaven.
